name: Qase
description: Qase is a test management platform for organizing manual and automated tests, managing test runs, and tracking software quality across development teams.

events.d: Create a test case with steps, severity and priority in a chosen project and suite.
Start a test run in a project with chosen cases, a test plan, or all cases, plus environment and milestone.
Update a test case's title, steps, severity, tags or other fields. Empty fields stay unchanged.
Find test cases in a project by name, suite, severity, status or other filters, or get one by ID.
Update a test run's title, description, environment, milestone, tags or configurations. Empty fields stay unchanged.
Mark a test run as complete so its results are final.
Log a defect in a project with its actual result, severity, milestone and tags.
Find test runs in a project by name, status, milestone, environment or start date, or get one by ID.
Record a pass, fail or other result for a test case in a test run, with comment, time and step results.
Change a defect's status to in progress, resolved or invalid.
Find defects in a project by status, or get one defect by ID.
Runs when a new test run starts in a chosen project, optionally for a milestone or environment.
Runs when a test run in a chosen project finishes (passed, failed or aborted).
Runs when a new test result is recorded in a chosen project, optionally for one run or status.
Runs when a new defect is logged in a chosen project.
